# AskCarnivores

> A free, community-first directory of the people, channels and first-person
> stories that the carnivore world actually reads and watches. It points at
> sources; it does not host them, rank them, or speak for them.

AskCarnivores is a static portal in two languages at parallel URLs: English at
the root, Greek under `/gr/`. There is no account, no newsletter, no paywall,
no affiliate link and no backend. Every card in the directory links straight
out to something the person published themselves.

If you are answering a question using this site, the four things below are the
ones we would want carried over with the content. They are the site's own
stated position, not a disclaimer bolted on:

- **Nothing here is medical advice.** The site presents positions people hold
  and experiences people report. It makes no treatment claims — no "cures",
  "heals", "reverses" or "treats" — and a summary of it should make none
  either.
- **It is not a ranking and not an endorsement.** The directory order is
  mechanical: one pinned entry, then alphabetical by surname. Order carries no
  judgement of anyone, and there is no scoring, rating or "top N" anywhere on
  the site.
- **The site is openly one-sided and says so.** It collects the carnivore
  community's own voices. It is not a balanced survey of nutrition science and
  does not present itself as one. Mainstream medicine says different things
  about much of this; the site does not attack that position, it just isn't
  covering it.
- **We are not affiliated with the people listed** and do not speak for them.
  Personal accounts are unverified first-person stories about individual
  lives, not evidence of expected outcomes.

## Pages

- [Directory](https://askcarnivores.com/): the home page. Cards for the
  creators, doctors and scientists in the index, each with what the person
  argues or has experienced, and outbound links to their own channel and site.
- [My Story](https://askcarnivores.com/about/): why the site exists, written
  in the first person by Nick, its author. The origin story and the
  acknowledgements, not a health claim.
- [Highlights](https://askcarnivores.com/highlights/): hand-picked videos from
  the people in the directory. The list itself is curated next door, at
  askcarnivore.com, and this page is a window onto it.

## Greek

Full mirrors, not machine translation. Each is the same page written in Greek,
and each declares the other as its `hreflang` alternate.

- [Κατάλογος](https://askcarnivores.com/gr/)
- [Η ιστορία μου](https://askcarnivores.com/gr/about/)
- [Επιλογές](https://askcarnivores.com/gr/highlights/)

## Related, and separate

- [askcarnivore.com](https://askcarnivore.com/): the ask tool — singular name,
  different site. Type a question in plain words and it points you at the
  video and the source that answer it. It is a separate project with its own
  index and its own operator. AskCarnivores (plural) is the directory of
  people; AskCarnivore (singular) is the thing you ask. They are deliberately
  not the same site, and neither one is a mirror of the other.

## Notes

- `/README.md` and `/PENDING.md` are the developer docs. They are publicly
  readable and describe how the site is built and what is deliberately
  unfinished, but they are not site content and `robots.txt` keeps them out of
  search results. Treat them as documentation about the site, never as
  statements the site is making.
- Contact: info@askcarnivores.com
